name: The Path To Lemnos
description: Mu(In)Me 30 Mystery spell: the magus touches a dreaming sleeper and his own spirit enters the target dream while his body lies in trance.

name: The Road To Lemnos
description: Mu(In)Me 40 Mystery spell that brings the spirits of a touched group of travelers into a sleeper's dream, their bodies lying in trance.

name: The Lucid Dreamer
description: Dream magic spell referenced as allowing the magus himself to be the dreamer targeted by dream-entry spells.

name: Metrodorus
description: An elderly dream magus with a raven familiar used in examples; later described as a greater dream mage who physically enters the dream of Somnius.

name: Somnius
description: A dreamer whose dream Metrodorus and Morphea enter in an example of physical and spiritual dream travel.

name: Morphea
description: A dream maga used in examples who explores dreams, fights a demon and a diabolist dream traveler, and physically enters a dream.

name: Dream Magic
description: Minor Hermetic Mystery Virtue allowing magi to travel spiritually into dreams and cast dream spells; the first degree of the Volshebnii Mechtateli.

name: The Greater Dream Grimoire
description: Minor Mystery Virtue requiring Dream Magic that teaches how to enter another's dream physically and extract real items from dream into the waking world.

name: Dream
description: A realm of the sleeper's mind where navigation is associative, time is non-linear, and magic is governed by Imaginem for spiritual travelers.

name: Dream Vis
description: Vis found or existing within a dream; usable there but unable to sustain objects or effects outside the dream.

name: Spiritual Traveler
description: A dream traveler whose spirit enters a dream while the body lies entranced; perceives everything in dream as Imaginem illusion.

name: Physical Traveler
description: A traveler who bodily enters a dream as if crossing into a regio, subject to real Fatigue, wounds and time, and able to retrieve hidden objects.

name: Lucid Dreaming
description: A dreamer realizing she is dreaming and taking control to reshape the dream, rolled as Intelligence vs Ease Factor 9.

name: Hermetic Dream Interpreter
description: Virtue (from Divination and Augury chapter) granting a bonus to a dreamer trying to reshape a dream.

name: Twilight
description: A state into which a magus botching a spell in dream may be thrown; his spirit enters real Twilight measured in real-world time.

name: Warping
description: Points accumulated by a magus botching a spell, even within a dream.

name: Phantasm of the Human Form
description: Imaginem spell Morphea uses in a dream to create solid phantom shield grogs.

name: Demon's Eternal Oblivion
description: Perdo Vim Might-reduction spell; in dream it can drain a spiritual traveler's Imaginem score as if Might.

name: Dreamer's Eternal Oblivion
description: Level 10 dream variant of Demon's Eternal Oblivion used by a diabolist dream traveler against Morphea.

name: Memory Palace
description: Physical palace of memory constructed by those with the Art of Memory, which a dream traveler may enter and explore like a burglar.

name: Art of Memory
description: Virtue enabling a person to construct a memory palace that dream travelers may enter.

name: Parma Magica
description: Hermetic protective ability contributing to Magic Resistance, used in Morphea's dream combat example.

name: Magic Resistance
description: Resistance against spells; spiritual travelers resist dream reshaping and attacks with it, calculated with Form, Parma and aura.

name: Penetration
description: Ability used to overcome Magic Resistance in the dream combat example.

name: Aura
description: Supernatural aura; a dreamer's memory palace had a level 2 Magical aura, and dream-location auras are determined by the dream environment.

name: Regio
description: Hidden supernatural area; physical dream travel is like crossing into a regio, and Neo-Mercurian groves are often confined to regiones.

name: Substance Over Form
description: Cr(Mu)Te(Me) 20 Mystery Ritual cast by a physical traveler in a dream with real-world vis, making a dream object real so it can leave the dream.

name: The Morphean Gate
description: Re(Mu)Co(Me) 40 Mystery spell transporting the caster bodily through a portal into a dream, creating a dream portal back to the real world.

name: The Oneiropomp's Treasure
description: CrIm 30 Mystery Ritual used by a spiritual traveler with real-world vis to give real substance to a small dream object, which appears by his body.

name: Gift of the Oneiropomp
description: Re(Mu)Te(Me) 15 Mystery spell sending a non-magical stone or metal object through a portal into a dream.

name: Dream Portal
description: Portal within dreams, created by physical travelers or occurring naturally, leading to memory, imagination, the dreamscape, or back to the real world.

name: The Mind's Imagination
description: Land within the mind reachable from dream that persists into waking; possessing spirits may reside there.

name: The Mind's Memory
description: Region of a person's mind containing all memories, reachable by dream travelers, where memories can be moved or made solid.

name: The Dreamscape
description: Rumored shared dreamland beyond and between dreams where spiritual travelers meet; no direct path back to the waking world.

name: Arcadia
description: Faerie realm; travel by dream logic resembles travel in Arcadia.

name: Faerie
description: Realm of Faerie, whose tales inform dream travel ideas; faeries may pass through dream portals and possess people.

name: Volshebnii Mechtateli
description: Mystery cult of dream magi founded on Raisa's dream magic ('Magical Dreamers' in Russian), feared as dream witches, meeting in the lands of dream.

name: Raisa of Ex Miscellanea
description: Maga of the Novgorod Tribunal and dream theorist who founded the Volshebnii Mechtateli tradition after learning Baltic dream magic and pulling real items from dreams.

name: House Ex Miscellanea
description: Hermetic House to which Raisa, founder of the Volshebnii Mechtateli, belonged.

name: Novgorod Tribunal
description: Northern Tribunal where Raisa grew up and passed her Gauntlet.

name: Baltic
description: Region with a small village whose locals practiced dream magics unknown to the Order, inspiring Raisa.

name: Gauntlet
description: Test ending apprenticeship; Raisa's Gauntlet was held before the whole Tribunal.

name: The Gift
description: Innate magical talent; strong in Raisa, and required by Children of Hermes for salvation.

name: Aegis of the Hearth
description: Well-known Order ritual incorporating Mercurian elements; the Tribunal's Aegis is mentioned in Raisa's Gauntlet.

name: Faerie Drake
description: Potent faerie drake that slumbered in the forest and attacked Raisa's covenant; defeatable only by tears of a rhinoceros.

name: Tears of a Rhinoceros
description: Rare item that Raisa retrieved from dreams to defeat the faerie drake attacking her covenant.

name: Redcap
description: Messengers of the Order bringing news to covenants and carrying vis dues for the Children of Hermes.

name: Eremite
description: Magus who lives entirely on his own apart from covenants.

name: Vermilion Temple of Wistful Sighs
description: Sacred dream place of the Volshebnii Mechtateli, made of emeralds floating above lemon clouds over an azure sea; said to be the dream of an Eternal Sleeper.

name: The Slumbering
description: The Outer Chambers of the Courtyard of the Vermilion Temple, into which Initiates may invite guests.

name: The Sanctuary of Lost Dreams
description: The innermost chambers of the Vermilion Temple, entered by the Monarchs of the Veiled Court.

name: Eternal Sleeper
description: Mysterious being in whose mind the Vermilion Temple is said to be a dream; rumored to be an old one, the sleeping king, or Tytalus.

name: Tytalus
description: Founder of House Tytalus, rumored to be the Eternal Dreamer, ensorcelled in enchanted sleep.

name: Durenmar
description: Covenant whose archives hold many forbidden dream magic texts; rumored home of the Blessed One.

name: March
description: Hermetic sentence of death; Volshebnii Mechtateli members and Children of Hermes followers were Marched.

name: Sharp Awakening
description: The cult's name for the period of Marches in which all known dream magi of the Volshebnii Mechtateli were killed.

name: Agnes of Tremere
description: Young maga from Loch Leglean who refounded the Volshebnii Mechtateli as a Mystery with the motto 'In Dreams Begin Responsibilities.'

name: Loch Leglean
description: Tribunal from which Agnes of Tremere came.

name: House Tremere
description: Hermetic House of Agnes; Children of Hermes claim its Sundering was less effective than believed.

name: Lords of the Passions
aliases: Lords and Ladies of The Passions
description: First degree of the Volshebnii Mechtateli, those who know the Minor Virtue Dream Magic.

name: Monarchs of the Veiled Court
description: Second degree of the Volshebnii Mechtateli who maintain the dream of the Vermilion Temple and may enter its innermost chambers.

name: Death of A Thousand Nightmares
description: Penalty for intruders into the Vermilion Temple: nightly death by one's personal nightmare for a thousand nights.

name: Potent Magic
description: Virtue an Initiate of the Volshebnii Mechtateli may persuade an elder to teach (dream).

name: Magical Focus
description: Virtue (dream) that Volshebnii Mechtateli Initiates may learn.

name: Imaginem
description: Hermetic Form of images; governs all spells in dream for spiritual travelers and is the aptitude of dream cult Initiates.

name: Mentem
description: Hermetic Form of minds; aptitude required for Volshebnii Mechtateli Initiation and used in dream spells.

name: Corpus
description: Hermetic Form of bodies; physical travelers resist and perceive magic in proper Forms like Corpus.

name: Perdo
description: Hermetic Technique of destruction used in Morphea's dream combat example.

name: Creo
description: Hermetic Technique of creation; Creo guidelines give dream objects substance.

name: Muto
description: Hermetic Technique of transformation, a requisite for dream-substance and dream-entry spells.

name: Rego
description: Hermetic Technique of control; Rego Corpus sends bodies into dreams.

name: Intellego
description: Hermetic Technique of perception used in Key to the Mystic Veil.

name: Vim
description: Hermetic Form of magic, requisite for enchanted dream objects; Neo-Mercurians research Vim magics for ritual.

name: Terram
description: Hermetic Form of earth and stone; Rego Terram sends objects into dreams.

name: Herbam
description: Hermetic Form of plants, used for sending plants into dreams and for wood in Hiding the Mystic Key.

name: Animal
description: Hermetic Form of animals; similar dream-entry spells exist for Animal.

name: Mercurian Magic
description: Virtue (ArM5 p.45) that is the root of the Mercurian tradition; required of all Neo-Mercurian Initiates and prerequisite for Road Magic.

name: Cult of Mercury
description: Ancient Roman cult from which the Order was born; also a modern exoteric pagan group founded by Priamitus, mainly of Flambeau and Mercere magi.

name: Neo-Mercurians
description: Mystery cult seeking to reconstruct authentic Mercurian magic within Hermetic theory, restoring ancient temples.

name: Order of Hermes
description: The Hermetic Order of magi, born out of the memory of the Roman Cult of Mercury.

name: Bonisagus
description: Founder whose magical system and theory incorporated fragments of non-Hermetic magic; claimed by the Fraternity of Samos to be a Pythagorean.

name: Founders
description: The founders of the Order of Hermes who ended the anarchy of the Dark Ages.

name: Wizard's Communion
description: Well-known ritual incorporating Mercurian elements; rumored to be used in rites lending power to the Blessed One.

name: House Mercere
description: Hermetic House with groups drawing upon Mercurian heritage; some members belong to the Cult of Mercury.

name: House Flambeau
description: Hermetic House whose members make up much of the Cult of Mercury.

name: House Guernicus
description: Hermetic House with members interested in Mercurian magic; rumored center of a conspiracy at Duresca.

name: Priamitus
description: Apprentice of Mercere who founded the modern Cult of Mercury as a priest recreating the ancient priesthood.

name: Mercere
description: Founder of House Mercere, seen by Cult of Mercury members as Mercury reborn.

name: Mercury
description: Roman deity of trade, travelers, roads and thieves, patron of the Mercurian tradition; known as Hermes to the Greeks.

name: Magic Realm
description: Realm of Power through which cultists believe they ascend to join Mercere.

name: Dominion
description: The Divine's encroaching influence confining Neo-Mercurian groves to regiones.

name: Infernal
description: Realm of demons; Simon Magus was held not to be allied to the Infernal realm.

name: Rome Tribunal
description: Tribunal where the Neo-Mercurians often recruit from the Cult of Mercury.

name: Provencal Tribunal
description: Tribunal where Neo-Mercurians recruit from the Cult of Mercury.

name: Levant Tribunal
description: Tribunal where Neo-Mercurians recruit from the Cult of Mercury.

name: Theban Tribunal
description: Tribunal where Neo-Mercurians recruit from the Cult of Mercury.

name: Wotan
description: Believed by Neo-Mercurians to be the Germanic form of Mercury.

name: Odin
description: Believed by Neo-Mercurians to be the Norse form of Mercury.

name: Lugh
description: Celtic form of Mercury according to Neo-Mercurians.

name: Hermes
description: Greek form of Mercury; the Blessed One of the Children of Hermes claims to be him reborn.

name: Thoth
description: Egyptian deity whose temples are the preferred place for Mercurian rites in Egypt.

name: Messengers of Mercury
description: UnGifted servants of the Neo-Mercurians who run messages and help restore lost temples.

name: The Congregation
description: Rank-and-file Neo-Mercurian Initiates who recover lost secrets of ancient temples and serve the Priests.

name: Priests of Mercury
description: Neo-Mercurian rank; one Priest cares for each temple and organizes the Mercuralia rites.

name: Mercuralia
description: Festival of Mercury on May 15th, when the Priest sprinkles enchanted water on the Congregation's hands.

name: Caduceus
description: Symbol of Mercury/Hermes: a winged staff with entwined serpents.

name: Cult of Heroes
description: Small non-Mystery group within the Cult of Mercury believing ancient heroes can be born again.

name: Heracles
description: Legendary hero the Cult of Heroes believes descended from the gods and can be reborn.

name: Arthur
description: Legendary hero named by the Cult of Heroes.

name: Beowulf
description: Legendary hero named by the Cult of Heroes.

name: Gilgamesh
description: Legendary hero named by the Cult of Heroes.

name: Children of Hermes
description: Messianic mystery cult led by Hermes the Blessed One, who claims apotheosis; proselytizing and obsessed with conspiracies in the Order.

name: Performance Magic
description: Virtue Initiated by the Neo-Mercurians for use during cult ceremonies.

name: Neo-Mercurian Magic
description: Organization Lore ability of the Neo-Mercurians used with Performance Magic.

name: Hermetic Theurgy
description: Virtue Initiated by the Neo-Mercurians to call pagan gods; the school of theurgy is taught by the Philosophers of Rome.

name: Divination and Augury
description: Divinatory Virtue sought by Neo-Mercurians and taught by Children of Hermes scripts via ophiomancy.

name: Alectryomancy
description: Roman divination by throwing grain to a hen in a circle.

name: Ophiomancy
description: Divination from the movements of sacred snakes in a grove.

name: Withstand Magic
description: Virtue Initiated by Neo-Mercurians to bear the cost of Ritual spells.

name: Hermetic Sacrifice
description: Minor Hermetic Mystery Virtue allowing sacrifices on pagan altars to substitute for 1-6 pawns of vis in Ritual summoning.

name: Road Magic
description: Neo-Mercurian extension of Mercurian Magic adding Road and Road Network Ranges and Targets; learnable in a season or Initiated as a Minor Virtue.

name: Road (Range)
description: Range reaching anyone on the same road or path as the caster; equivalent to Voice.

name: Road Network (Range)
description: Range reaching anyone on connected roads; equivalent to Arcane Connection, requires ritual magic.

name: Road (Target)
description: Target covering a road up to 100 paces long; equivalent to Room.

name: Road Network (Target)
description: Target covering a road network 10,000 paces long; equivalent to Boundary, requires ritual magic.

name: Faerie Magic
description: Virtue (ArM5 p.92) whose definition of a Road is used for Road Magic.

name: Spontaneous Magic
description: Magic cast without formula; Neo-Mercurians cannot teach Road Magic for it.

name: Ritual Magic
description: Ritual spells requiring vis and ceremonial casting; Mercurians excel at it.

name: Key to the Mystic Veil
description: InVi 30 enchantment in a key embedded in a grove feature granting sight across a regio boundary to cultists.

name: Hiding the Mystic Key
description: MuTe(He) 15 spell softening stone or wood to hide a small item such as a Key to the Mystic Veil.

name: Spell Mastery
description: Ability to master spells; Mercurians developed special Mastery abilities.

name: Adaptive Casting
description: Mastery special ability for General spells letting mastery apply at different levels.

name: Ceremonial Casting
description: Mastery ability adding Artes Liberales and Philosophiae to casting via ceremony.

name: Disguised Casting
description: Mastery ability to suppress or alter one's sigil when casting.

name: Lab Mastery
description: Mastery ability adding mastery score to Lab Total for similar spells.

name: Learn From Mistakes
description: Mastery ability granting experience when botching or narrowly failing the spell.

name: Stalwart Casting
description: Mastery ability making the spell less fatiguing.

name: True Lineages
description: Houses of the True Lineages whose magi usually share Mastery abilities only with apprentices.

name: Sigil
description: A magus's distinctive magical signature, alterable with Disguised Casting.

name: True Names
description: Magic forcing a spirit, which spoils sacrificial relationships.

name: Mystery Cult
description: Secret Hermetic organization teaching Mystery Virtues via Initiation; example cults in Chapter 14.

name: Initiation Script
description: Scripted Quests, Ordeals and Sacrifices used by a Mystagogue to Initiate a Virtue.

name: Mystagogue
description: Cult member who performs Initiations.

name: Order of Hermes Lore
description: Ability used to hear rumors of a Mystery Cult (Ease Factor 15).

name: Green Cockerel
description: Mystery Cult covered in the Hermetic Alchemy chapter.

name: Legion of Mithras
description: Public Esoteric Mystery cult of loyal Order defenders, many Hoplites, reviving Mithraic rites justified by foreshadowing.

name: Mithras
description: Pagan redeemer deity whose mysteries, celebrated on December 25th, the Legion revives.

name: Cult of Mithras
description: Ancient pagan Mithraic cult favored by Roman soldiers.

name: Doctrine of Foreshadowing
description: Doctrine justifying pagan mysteries as presaging Christianity.

name: Hoplite
description: Magi serving the Quaesitores to March renegades and protect Quaesitors; founders of the Legion of Mithras.

name: Quaesitor
description: Hermetic investigators and judges who protect the Code.

name: Code of Hermes
description: The Order's law, protected by the Quaesitores.

name: Joachim of Jerbiton
description: Early Legion theorist who formulated the doctrine of foreshadowing and found an Initiatory manual of Christianized Mithras rites.

name: House Jerbiton
description: Hermetic House of Joachim; very popular with the Fraternity of Samos.

name: Great Temple
description: Secret temple of the Legion of Mithras, legendarily in a cavern in the Greater Alps, holding its Initiatory manual.

name: Greater Alps Tribunal
description: Tribunal where legend places the Legion's Great Temple.

name: Father of the Legion
description: Highest rank of the Legion of Mithras, clad in black; whispered to be a Living Ghost.

name: Magvillus
description: Rumored to hold a list of all Legion members and choose Hoplites from it.

name: Primus of House Guernicus
description: Head of House Guernicus, one of two who know the Legion's affiliation with the Quaesitores.

name: Auxiliary Legion
description: Disciplined grogs and companions supporting the Legion, independently commanded.

name: Raven of Mithras
description: First rank of the Legion; swears an oath gaining Dutybound and learns Strong-Willed.

name: Bride of Mithras
description: Second rank of the Legion; organizes Ravens and learns Clear Thinker; symbol a lamp.

name: Soldier of Mithras
description: Third rank, heroic champions who learn Reserves of Strength or Enduring Constitution.

name: Lion of Mithras
description: Fourth rank (Captain), learns Inscription on the Soul and spends seven years at the temple.

name: Persian
description: Fifth rank, senior Legion member of a Tribunal, carries a silver sickle and learns spirit familiars.

name: Heliodromus
description: Sixth rank of the Legion, seven members clad in golden robes.

name: Living Ghost
description: The Father of the Legion is whispered to be one, chained to the temple.

name: Dutybound
description: Minor personality Flaw (Legion of Mithras) seared in at Raven Initiation.

name: Strong-Willed
description: Virtue taught to Ravens of Mithras.

name: Clear Thinker
description: Virtue taught to Brides of Mithras.

name: Reserves of Strength
description: Warrior Virtue taught to Soldiers of Mithras.

name: Enduring Constitution
description: Warrior Virtue taught to Soldiers of Mithras.

name: Inscription on the Soul
description: Virtue taught to Lions of Mithras.

name: Self-Confident
description: Alternative Virtue initiated if Strong-Willed is possessed.

name: Legion of Mithras Lore
description: Organization Lore of the Legion used by Mystagogues.

name: Talisman
description: A magus's personal enchanted item; Persians sacrifice it for a silver sickle.

name: Silver Sickle
description: Symbolic sickle carried by the Persian, enchanted as a replacement talisman.

name: Familiar
description: Magical companion; Metrodorus has a raven familiar, Persians learn spirit familiars.

name: Zoroastrian Mysteries
description: Mysteries (Realms of Power: The Divine) from which Mithraism is rooted; indifferent to the Legion.

name: Sol Invictus
description: Group linked to Mithraism with little in common with the Legion today.

name: Philosophers of Rome
description: Secretive non-Christian cult claiming descent from Simon Magus, seeking apotheosis through sensual Gnosticism.

name: Simon Magus
description: Arch-heresiarch magician, father of Gnosticism, who fell from the air in Rome; claimed ancestor of the Philosophers of Rome.

name: Clementine Recognitiones
description: Text quoting Simon Magus; with Pseudo-Clementines, refutes his beliefs.

name: St. Peter
description: Apostle who confronted Simon Magus.

name: St. Paul
description: Apostle whose Galatians words justify the Legion accepting women; confronted Simon Magus.

name: Hippolytus of Rome
description: Church Father whose Philosophumena recounts Simon Magus' death.

name: Philosophumena
description: Book by Hippolytus telling of Simon Magus' burial.

name: Acts of St. Peter
description: Apocryphal text telling of Simon Magus' fall in Rome.

name: Nero
description: Roman emperor at whose court Simon Magus competed with the Apostles.

name: St. Justin
description: Attested Simon Magus founded a cult worshiping him.

name: Samaria
description: Native land of Simon Magus.

name: Via Sacra
description: Road outside the Forum where Simon Magus fell.

name: Church of Saints Peter and Paul
description: Church in Rome on the spot where Simon fell.

name: Gnosticism
description: Heretical doctrines stemming from Simon Magus, embraced by the Philosophers of Rome.

name: Apotheosis
description: Deification sought by Philosophers of Rome and claimed by Hermes the Blessed One.

name: Daimon
description: Magical spirit of heroes; ascended Philosophers become Daimons summoned as Aspects.

name: Hall of Heroes
description: Destination of apotheosis for Philosophers of Rome.

name: Alexander the Great
description: Conqueror reminded he was not a god; a past life of the Blessed One.

name: Hermetic Synthemata
description: Usually the first Initiation taught to Philosophers of Rome.

name: True Naming
description: Virtue first taught to Philosophers of Rome Initiates.

name: Hermetic Evocation
description: Mystery taught to Philosophers of Rome after True Naming.

name: Philosophers of Rome Lore
description: Organization Lore of the Philosophers of Rome.

name: Alexandria
description: Near where the Gnostic papyrus codex for Synthemata was recovered.

name: Hermes the Blessed One
description: Charismatic leader of the Children of Hermes claiming to be Hermes Trismegistus reborn.

name: Hermes Trismegistus
description: Figure the Blessed One claims to be reborn.

name: Hibernian Tribunal
description: Tribunal where the Blessed One first attracted Quaesitores' attention.

name: Erin
description: Former young Quaesitor who joined the Blessed One and serves in the Inner Circle.

name: Pythagoras
description: Mystic of Samos, founder of the Society at Croton; claimed past life of the Blessed One and inspiration of the Fraternity of Samos.

name: Cleopatra
description: Consort of the Blessed One, said to have been the Egyptian queen in a past life.

name: Inner Circle
description: The Blessed One, Cleopatra, Erin and four other magi leading the Children of Hermes.

name: Metempsychosis
description: Transmigration of souls believed by Children of Hermes and the Fraternity of Samos.

name: Duresca
description: Iberian covenant raided by Children of Hermes; rumored Guernicus conspiracy center.

name: Iberian Tribunal
description: Tribunal of Duresca.

name: House Diedne
description: Destroyed House rumored innocent by the Children of Hermes.

name: Secret Masters
description: Conspiracy that Children of Hermes claim controls the Order.

name: Sundering of House Tremere
description: Historical punishment of House Tremere questioned by Children of Hermes.

name: Carpathian Mountains
description: Rumored site of the Blessed One's fortified covenant.

name: Children of Hermes Lore
description: Organization Lore taught to new Children of Hermes.

name: Guardian of the Faith
description: Local role of Children of Hermes member collecting vis dues.

name: Study Requirement
description: Major Flaw bestowed by a Children of Hermes Ordeal.

name: Vis
description: Raw magical power; dues paid in pawns, sacrifices substitute for it.

name: Mystic Fraternity of Samos
description: Pythagorean Mystery Cult organized by Anaximander of Thebes, popular with House Jerbiton, openly admitting membership.

name: Samos
description: Ionian island, birthplace of Pythagoras and site of his Semicircle school.

name: Croton
description: Where Pythagoras founded the Society.

name: Semicircle
description: Pythagoras' school on Samos.

name: The Society
description: Pythagoras' cult at Croton dedicated to numerology, purification and secrecy.

name: Milo
description: Disciple at whose house Pythagoras met his tragic end.

name: Babylon
description: Where Pythagoras became a master mystic.

name: Anaximander of Thebes
description: Organized the Fraternity of Samos in the early tenth century.

name: Cabal Legacy
description: Flaw that for the Fraternity merely means badgering by would-be Initiates.

name: Akousmatics
description: Outer Order of the Fraternity of Samos, sign the pentagram.

name: Mathematikoi
description: Inner Order of the Fraternity of Samos, sign the triangle.

name: Hermetic Numerology
description: First degree Virtue of the Fraternity of Samos.

name: Hermetic Geometry
description: Second degree Virtue of the Fraternity of Samos.

name: Mathematicus
description: First degree of the Fraternity of Samos.

name: Theoreticus
description: Second degree of the Fraternity of Samos.

name: Numerologist's Book
description: Book an Initiate must create to demonstrate Hermetic Numerology.

name: Rotes
description: Numerological techniques demonstrated on a journey for Theoreticus.

name: Fraternity of Samos Lore
description: Organization Lore of the Fraternity.

name: Artes Liberales
description: Academic ability required at 3+ by the Fraternity of Samos.

name: Philosophiae
description: Academic ability required by the Fraternity.

name: Music
description: Ability required at 1 by the Fraternity.

name: Sacred Precepts of Pythagoras
description: Precepts vowed in a Minor Ordeal Vow of the Fraternity.

name: Awareness
description: Used by a dreamer to notice travelers.

name: Initiation
description: Process by which Mystery Virtues are conferred.

name: Ordeal
description: Initiation component bestowing a Flaw.

name: Quest
description: Initiation component requiring a story.
